book.name: Lɛme
book.title: Ŋwa wu Lɛme chi booŋ ba ntuŋ ba Jiso

content: No ba yuuyi Tifiŋ, Sol tooŋ. Sol nya ŋgɛ kintaashɛ ki bamii ba mbɛmɛ le Gɛh abvu, bo kɛ bo nyaa ŋgɛ wu tɛɛme kintaashɛ ki bamii ba mbɛmɛ ba Yɛlusalɛm le. Ki saaŋe kichii ki bu yo, ki gɛɛŋ bimbe bi Judia bɛ Samaliya le, shɛɛ gɛh booŋ ba ntuŋ ba Jiso.
Bilɛŋsɛ bamu ba gɛ̀ leesɛ muntele yi Nyo le chuule to bo jo gvunɛ chi Tifiŋ bo jiiyɛ, bo bee wu wesee.
Geenɛ, Sol nyu fie wu gɛɛne lo bɛ kintaashɛ ki bamii ba mbɛmɛ, wu kooyi bamii ba mbɛmɛ, lɛ yeh lɛ yeh, ba bilɛŋsɛ bɛ bikɛse wu tunɛ yeh yi ncha le.
Filib fejɛ jɛ yi Nyo Samaliya
Bamii ba gɛ̀ saaŋe baa tu bo gɛɛne manjuu le manchii bo feeji jɛ yi Nyo.
Filib bu fie wu gɛɛŋ nyu a kilaantɛŋ ki Samaliya le, wu tu wu feeji saaka yo kune Mbvusɛ wù Nyo gɛ̀ ka.
Bamii ba duude yuge bo ka yɛnɛ mwɛɛ mù duunyi bvuŋga bvu Nyo mù wu gɛ̀ gee le, bo mo bo nya bintuŋ wu le chuule.
Biyo bì yiide gɛ̀ bude yi bamii le, bi wanɛ fɛwɛɛwe, bamii ba duude ba gɛ̀ kwe kimbe kimimia mo batɛŋɛlase bo ja we tɛ.
Noo, kinlaŋye kì baaŋ tu ki nyu a kilaantɛŋ kiyu le.
Muh mu gɛ̀ bee a kilaantɛŋ kiyu le jee che nyu lɛ Samoŋ, wu gɛ̀ shɛɛ gɛh wu duunyi nfiŋ ye kɛge lo, bamii ba Samaliya bachii yɛde jwe yune bo. Wu ka duu lɛ wu le muh wù baaŋ.
Bamii bachii ba a kilaantɛŋ kiyu le kɛge ba shige shige le gɛɛne ba baaŋ baaŋ le bo nya bintuŋ wu le, bo duu lɛ, “Muh wunɛ le bvuŋga bvu Nyo bvù ba tɛŋe lɛ le Bvuŋga bvù Baaŋ.”
Bo gɛ̀ nyaa bintuŋ wu le noo, nje wu gɛ̀ shee wu duunyi nfiŋ ye kɛge lo je yì ndefe le bamii yɛde jwe yune bo.
Geenɛ, Filib gɛ̀ doo wu to wu feeji saaka wù joŋe kune bvunfoŋ bvu Nyo mo kune jee chi Jiso Kletu, bikɛse bɛ bilɛŋsɛ bɛɛŋ saaka wuyu le wu mo leesɛ bo a joo.
Samoŋ wɛɛ kibɛɛ bɛɛŋ tɛ ba leesɛ wu a joo. Wu mo wu mɛ gɛh wù nyu mbebe yi Filib le wu yɛde biŋgha bi mwɛɛ bì baaŋ baaŋ bɛ mwɛɛ mù duunyi bvuŋga bvu Nyo mù wu gɛ̀ gee jwe yune wu.
Booŋ ba ntuŋ ba Jiso gɛ̀ yu Yɛlusalɛm lɛ bamii ba Samaliya le bo fi wa jɛ yi Nyo, bo mo bo tuŋ Bita bɛ Joŋ fɛ bo le.
Bo gɛɛŋ bo bu yo, bo buunɛ fɛ bamii ba mbɛmɛ ba yo le lɛ bo kɛmɛ Kiyo ki Yuude,
nje Kiyo ki Yuude gɛ̀ baaŋ a to gɛ fɛ muh lɛ bo le gɛ. Ba gɛ̀ leesɛ bo nyu a joo maa a jee chi Tada Jiso le.
Bita bɛ Joŋ buunɛ, bo gɛɛ chiaaŋ yi bo le, bo mo bo kɛmɛ Kiyo ki Yuude.
Samoŋ doo wu yɛŋ no booŋ ba ntuŋ ba Jiso gɛɛde chiaaŋ yi bamii le Kiyo ki Yuude too yi bo le, wu nya bige Bita bɛ Joŋ le,
wu du lɛ, “Bɛŋ nya mɛ bɛ bvuŋga bvunɛ tɛ, fi le lɛ mo nyu yɛɛŋ wù nle ŋgɛɛ chiaaŋ yaŋ yi ye ye le, wu kɛmɛ Kiyo ki Yuude.”
Bita chvuu wu le lɛ, “Wo bɛ bige biuŋ biyu bɛŋ lé bɛŋ lɛ̂sɛ lo. Wo jiɛnyi nɛɛ fɛ wo kwaji lɛ taŋlo ba gu nyaa yi le yi Nyo bɛ bige?
Gɛ wo kɛme lo kijusɛ antɛnɛɛ a lɛme chinɛ gɛ, nje gɛ fitele fiuŋ yuude fɛ Nyo le gɛ.
Kaasɛ fitele fiuŋ yi fiɛɛ fì befe fì wo goone ki wo gê finɛ le, wo buunɛ laa taŋlo Tada Nyo lɛɛshɛ baŋkwajɛ ba befe banɛ ba wo kɛme fɛ fitele le la.
N'yɛde lɛ wo le wo yisɛ wa bɛ n'yɛlɛ ajii, wo tu nfwa wu kimbefɛ.”
Samoŋ chooŋɛ Bita bɛ Joŋ lɛ, “Kii, bɛŋ buunɛ fɛ Tada le lɛ keefɛ fiɛɛ fimi antɛnɛɛ a mwɛɛ mu bɛŋ jɛme munɛ kooshɛ bɛ mɛ gɛ.”

Bita bɛ Joŋ gɛ̀ mɛsɛ bo fejɛ jɛ yi Tada, bo sɛɛŋ mwɛɛ mù bo kee kune Jiso, bo ja bo tuu jiŋ Yɛlusalɛm. No bo gɛ̀ tuu jiŋ noo, bo fede bantɛ ba duude ba Samaliya le, bo feeji saaka wù joŋe wu le wù Nyo yo.
Filib leesɛ muh wu Itobia a joo
Nchɛndaa Tada gɛ̀ ja wu jɛmɛ Filib le lɛ, “Ja wo boh je akuu akuu, wo gɛɛŋ a je yì jade Yɛlusalɛm yi fede nchvuuŋ yi gɛɛne Gasa le.”

Filib ja wu boge. Muh wù baaŋ wumu wu Itobia gɛ̀ bee yo a je. Wu gɛ̀ bee muh wù ba bvuushɛ, nyu muh wù gɛ̀ jiiŋe fɛ kwa wu Yaa Kanda wù gɛ̀ sage woŋ wu Itobia le. Muh wɛɛ gɛ̀ ja Yɛlusalɛm a wu gɛ gɛnɛ ki wu bûunɛ Nyo yo,
wu tu wu tuu jiŋ woŋ we le a koto kimu ki nyáŋ gɛ̀ chiide le, wù nyu wu shii yo, wu tɛŋe fiɛɛ a Ŋwa wù Yosaya wù muh wu ntuŋ wu Nyo gɛ̀ saŋ le.
Kiyo ki Yuude jɛmɛ Filib le lɛ, “Kɛŋsɛ wo gɛɛŋ mbebe koto kege le.”
Filib legɛ wu gɛɛŋ mbebe ki le, wu yu muh wɛɛ tɛŋe a ŋwa wu Yosaya le. Wu bii wu le lɛ, “Wo tɛŋe nɛ wo yuge fiɛɛ fì wu jɛme?”
Wu chvuu lɛ, “Taŋlo n'yu nɛɛ njɛ muh najɛ mɛne sɛŋ?” Wu jɛmɛ lɛ Filib bɛɛŋ bo shii a koto le.

content.text: Kijusɛ kì wu gɛ̀ tɛŋe fo a Ŋwa wɛɛ le gɛ̀ jɛme lɛ,
“Wu gɛ̀ bee njɛ shoŋ yì ba gɛɛne ki ba sɛɛ,
ka nyu njɛ mwa shoŋ sege ba muu yvú ye ye le,
Le gɛh tɛ noo no wù gɛ̀ bee jwe wu chile.
Ba gɛ̀ choosɛ wu, ba faŋ ki ba sa nsa we chuule.
Le yɛɛŋ wu yu wu to wu jɛme kune booŋ be,
a ba suuŋ wa kinche ke fɛkuu fɛnɛ?”

content: Muh wù baaŋ wɛɛ mo wu lɛgɛ Filib wu jɛmɛ lɛ, “Kii wo, gɛ̀ sɛɛŋ mɛ, muh wu ntuŋ wu Nyo wunɛ, wu jɛme nyu kune yɛɛŋ? Wu jɛme kune kikwɛɛ ke noo kune muh mu le?”
Filib mo wu kɛ gɛh bɛ kijusɛ kiyu a Ŋwa wɛɛ le, wu tu wu naji saaka wù joŋe wu kune Jiso.
Bɛ wu tu bo gɛɛne gɛh a je, bo gɛɛŋ bo bu fɛ kijusɛ kimi le joo nyu fo. Muh wù baaŋ wɛɛ jɛmɛ lɛ, “Bîjɛ yɛ̂ŋ, yinɛ le joo fɛnɛ, taŋlo ŋka nfaŋ la lɛ, keefɛ wo lêe mɛ a joo?” [
Filib chvuu wu le lɛ, “Wo fɛnɛ le wo bɛɛŋ Jiso Kletu le bɛ fitele fiuŋ fichii, tu nle nlee wo a joo.” Wu chvuu lɛ, “Nle mbɛɛŋ lɛ Jiso Kletu le Mwa Nyo.”]
Muh wù baaŋ wɛɛ mo wu du lɛ bo lɛɛŋ bɛ koto. Bɛ Filib shii, bo lee bo gɛɛŋ a joo, Filib leesɛ wu a joo.
No bo gɛ̀ bude a joo, Kiyo ki Tada chufɛ Filib fo, muh wù baaŋ wɛɛ gɛ ka wu yɛŋ wu le gɛ. Geenɛ, wu tu wu gɛɛne gɛh fie wu laŋeye.
Filib ja wu bunɛ nyu wa Asotu, wu ja wu tu wu gɛɛne, wu fede a bilaantɛŋ le bichii, wu feeji saaka wù joŋe wu Nyo, wu gɛɛŋ wu bu a kilaantɛŋ ki Kasalia le.

footnotes.text: Baŋwa ba kege bamu kɛme kinchiŋ kinɛ nyu fɛ chiŋ fɛ kimba kinɛ.
